lesson.title: 911 - Procedure 200 : Event Creation
objectives: Explain the purpose of event creation.
Identify required information for creating events.
Apply correct procedures when creating events.
Ensure accuracy and accountability during event creation.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of Procedure 200?
questions.hints: This procedure starts the lifecycle of an incident.

choices.text: Creating events in the CAD system

questions.stem: Procedure 200 governs how events are created in ICAD.
questions.hints: This procedure occurs before dispatching units.

questions.stem: All incidents must be entered into the CAD system as an ________.
questions.hints: This is the formal record of an incident.

questions.stem: Match the term to its purpose.
questions.hints: Each term plays a role in event creation.

questions.stem: Who is responsible for creating events under Procedure 200?
questions.hints: This role controls the radio position.

questions.stem: Dispatchers are accountable for the accuracy of events they create.
questions.hints: Responsibility does not transfer after entry.

questions.stem: The dispatcher remains ________ for the event once it is created.
questions.hints: Another word for responsible.

questions.stem: Match the responsibility to the correct role.
questions.hints: Each role contributes differently.

questions.stem: Which information is required to create an event?
questions.hints: An event must be tied to a place and type.

questions.stem: An event may be created without a verified location.
questions.hints: Location is fundamental to dispatching.

questions.stem: Events must include an accurate ________ to allow proper response.
questions.hints: This tells units where to respond.

questions.stem: Match the event element to its function.
questions.hints: Each element serves a unique purpose.

questions.stem: When should an event be created?
questions.hints: Think at the first recognition of an incident.

choices.text: As soon as an incident is identified

questions.stem: Delaying event creation can impact response effectiveness.
questions.hints: Events drive dispatching actions.

questions.stem: Procedure 200 emphasizes ________ creation of events.
questions.hints: This relates to speed.

questions.stem: Match the timing to its impact.
questions.hints: Each timing affects response differently.

questions.stem: What should a dispatcher do if information is incomplete during event creation?
questions.hints: Procedure favors action with updates later.

choices.text: Wait until all details are known
Create the event and update as information develops

questions.stem: Events may be updated after creation as new information is received.
questions.hints: Creation is not the final step.

questions.stem: Additional details should be added to the event ________.
questions.hints: This field holds narrative updates.

questions.stem: Match the action to its result.
questions.hints: Each action affects accuracy.

questions.stem: Why is accuracy critical during event creation?
questions.hints: Errors affect unit deployment.

choices.text: To ensure proper response and resource allocation

questions.stem: Inaccurate event creation can lead to improper responses.
questions.hints: Errors propagate downstream.

questions.stem: Procedure 200 stresses the importance of ________ information.
questions.hints: This word describes correctness.

questions.stem: Match the error to its consequence.
questions.hints: Each mistake has a different impact.

questions.stem: Which system is used to create events?
questions.hints: This is the primary dispatch system.

questions.stem: ICAD is the system used for event creation and tracking.
questions.hints: This system supports dispatch operations.

questions.stem: Events are created and maintained within the ________ system.
questions.hints: Same system used for unit status.

questions.stem: Match the system to its function.
questions.hints: One stores data, one transmits voice.

questions.stem: If unsure about how to create an event, what should the dispatcher do?
questions.hints: Procedure encourages guidance when uncertain.

questions.stem: Supervisory guidance may be sought when event creation procedures are unclear.
questions.hints: This is encouraged, not discouraged.

questions.stem: Procedure 200 allows dispatchers to seek ________ when unsure.
questions.hints: Another word for advice.

questions.stem: Match the priority to its operational benefit.
questions.hints: Each priority supports effectiveness.
